description: This Java interface defines a builder pattern for constructing responses to 'RetrieveFeature' commands within a live signals command framework. It provides methods for generating success and error responses based on the retrieval outcome of a Feature object.

classes.name: RetrieveFeatureLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: An interface extending the query command response step, designed for building responses to retrieve feature commands.

classes.name: RetrieveFeatureLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: An inner interface that provides methods to create success and error responses for RetrieveFeature commands.

methods.name: retrieved
methods.description: Creates a response containing the retrieved feature value. Throws NullPointerException if feature is null.

methods.name: featureNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating the feature does not exist or access is insufficient.
